title: Separate release readiness from runtime exact-source evidence
rawUserRequest: Continue the authorized plan, but stop repeating release-freeze repairs. Find and implement a root-cause solution; include open PRs #528 and #529 in the analysis and stop again if the direction is not converging.

declaredIntent.summary: Eliminate recurring release-freeze invalidation by separating repository readiness from runtime exact-source release evidence, and add a no-publication rehearsal of the release path.

outOfScope: Creating, moving, deleting, or publishing v0.5.45 or any other semantic Git tag, GitHub Release, or public asset.
Changing the v0.5.45 candidate identity or mutating v0.5.43/v0.5.44.
Merging #528 or #529 directly, or editing immutable historical archive evidence.
Changing unrelated runtime/product behavior or reducing required Hosted CI.

riskAssessment.reason: This changes the boundary between local readiness and hosted exact-source evidence. A mistake could permit an unverified release or create another recovery loop.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized root-cause remediation and continuous execution, while requiring a new pause if evidence shows the solution does not converge.

preReviewWarnings: Do not weaken exact-source checks after runtime finalization.
A rehearsal must be incapable of creating a tag, Release, or public asset.
Do not directly merge stale PRs #528/#529; analyze and close them only after replacement coverage is proved.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record intent and evidence boundaries before modifying release control flow.

acceptance: A repository-readiness command verifies candidate state, required Japanese evidence, policy, and absence of active Work Items without requiring committed freeze bytes to equal the current source tree.
The hosted release workflow still materializes runtime freeze on the exact current default-branch source and performs strict source/archive/digest validation before any tag or Release mutation.
A no-publication release rehearsal executes the same exact-source preparation and evidence path, and static plus executable regressions prove that it cannot create tags, Releases, or assets.
A source commit after an old freeze no longer requires a new freeze Work Item merely to run readiness or rehearsal; exact runtime evidence remains mandatory for an actual release.
Documentation explicitly distinguishes readiness, runtime evidence, rehearsal, and publication; it records #528/#529 as stale superseded PRs and does not claim v0.5.45 is published.
guidelines: Maintain fail-closed behavior at every publication boundary.
Prefer one authoritative runtime evidence path over duplicated stale snapshots.
Do not treat a successful dry-run as a published release.
Preserve exact SHA, required CI jobs, human approval, SBOM, and provenance requirements for actual publication.

intent.problem: The repository currently requires a committed premerge freeze to match current main before dispatch, while release.yml independently materializes and validates the authoritative freeze in an exact detached runtime checkout. Every corrective PR after premerge freeze changes included source bytes and invalidates the committed snapshot, forcing another freeze Work Item. PR #533 reproduced this after #531/#532; #528 and #529 are earlier stale attempts at adjacent symptoms.
constraints: Keep actual publication fail-closed and exact-source-bound.
No release/tag/asset mutation in this corrective Work Item.
Use test-first changes and Hosted CI.
The rehearsal must share the release preparation path rather than becoming a weaker parallel implementation.
Do not merge #528 or #529 directly; close their stale branches only after the successor proves replacement coverage.
intent.rationale: Committed premerge metadata is not authoritative for a later source commit; it is a historical preparation record. Repository readiness must validate stable policy facts, while runtime exact-source evidence must be generated and checked once at the real source boundary. A non-publishing rehearsal catches structural release errors before publication without reintroducing snapshot churn.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized efficiency exception; focused regression verification and full Hosted CI remain mandatory.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized continuous root-cause correction of governed release workflow and documentation, while reserving actual publication to a later Work Item.

rollbackNote: If the revised split cannot demonstrate exact runtime enforcement and no-publication rehearsal isolation, stop and retain this diagnosis rather than merging a partial redesign.
